title: Jiggly Polish Bun Pierogi
description: A savory, molten Polish dish featuring crispy bun and tandoor-seared pierogi, served as a solo dinner option, and is kosher-friendly.
instructions: Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles using a cookie cutter or a glass.
Place a tablespoon of filling in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal the pierogi.
Fry the pierogi in hot oil until golden brown.
Drain on paper towels, then serve hot with melted butter and chopped chives.
Split the bun in half horizontally and toast until lightly browned.
Assemble the pierogi by placing them on top of the bun, then spooning melted butter over the top.
Serve immediately, garnished with chopped chives if desired.
Prepare the filling by mixing together cottage cheese, egg, salt, and pepper.
Add chopped chives and grated cheese to the filling for extra flavor.
Adjust the seasoning as needed to taste.
